# Corundum HFT (vendored)

Copy of [Corundum HFT](https://github.com/SemyonZamiakin/CorundumHFT) 1.1.0 (`include/corundum/corundum.h`, `src/corundum.c`), MIT, same authors.
Euclase Light uses it to read the metrics that Euclase Monitor publishes. `include/ql/metrics_wire.h` is a copy of the same file in Euclase Monitor. Update both files together.
